project_type: npm-workspaces monorepo: apps/api (NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL) + apps/web (Next.js App Router mobile-first PWA). Repo was docs-only before this task (no apps/, no root package.json, no .github/) — code side is greenfield built on existing docs.
build_system: npm workspaces (root package.json workspaces: apps/*). Root lint/test/build scripts fan out to workspaces with --if-present. QUIRK: PowerShell execution policy blocks npm.ps1 — in this shell you MUST invoke npm.cmd / npx.cmd, never bare npm/npx. Local Node v24.15.0; CI pins Node 20 LTS — code must build/test on both. npm 11.12.1.
test_framework: API: Jest (NestJS default), Prisma client mocked — no live DB. Web: Vitest + React Testing Library (chosen for low Next transform friction), fetch/api-client mocked.
build_command: npm.cmd run build  (root; fans out: apps/api runs `prisma generate` then `nest build`, apps/web runs `next build`). Must succeed with NO live Postgres and NO live API.
test_command: npm.cmd run test  (root; apps/api jest, apps/web vitest run). Must succeed with NO live Postgres.
verification_instructions: From repo root in PowerShell, these four must all exit 0 with NO Postgres and NO API running: `npm.cmd install`, `npm.cmd run lint`, `npm.cmd run build`, `npm.cmd run test`. Per-workspace during dev: `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run build|test|lint`, `npm.cmd --workspace apps/web run build|test|lint`. prisma generate must run with no DB: `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api exec prisma generate`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma Client is generated by `prisma generate` (run in API postinstall or build); it needs no live DB. Do not commit generated client or node_modules. next build output (.next) and nest dist are build artifacts, gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. Use npm.cmd/npx.cmd (npm.ps1 blocked). Do NOT require a live PostgreSQL for build or unit tests — mock Prisma in tests, prisma generate only (no migrate/seed). Seed and `prisma migrate` need a DB at RUNTIME only. Web menu page must CLIENT-fetch so `next build` needs no live API. Work on branch sprint-1/mvp-menu; do NOT push or open a PR.
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits (feat(api):, feat(web):, test:, ci:, chore:). Branch strategy: feature work on sprint-1/mvp-menu, never push to main. Definition of Done: no lint/typecheck errors, unit+integration tests written and passing locally and in CI. Do NOT modify substance of README.md, .env.example, or docs/ — additive only. .gitignore must keep node_modules/.next/dist/.env and may be extended.
key_patterns: ADR-001 monorepo apps/web+apps/api+docs+tests. ADR-002 Next.js App Router, mobile-first 375-430px, THREE required UI states Loading/Empty/Error with Retry button. ADR-003 NestJS modular: products belong to a CatalogModule; use class-validator + global ValidationPipe (whitelist). ADR-004 Prisma + Prisma Migrate (prisma/migrations). .env contract: API PORT=3001, CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000, DATABASE_URL postgresql://brew:brew@localhost:5432/brewlite?schema=public; Web NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001, PORT=3000.
relevant_files: README.md (monorepo structure, branch + commit conventions, DoD — do not rewrite)
.env.example (environment contract — honor exactly, do not edit)
docs/diagrams/class-domain.puml (AUTHORITATIVE domain model: Product fields + all enums/entities for Prisma schema)
directory_structure: Root: README.md, .env.example, .gitignore, docs/ (requirements/, diagrams/ with .puml+.svg, architecture/ with adr/), .agents/tasks/ (plan + FEAT artifacts).
